add.description: The package carries an ~0.008 comment ratio with zero docstrings, and the code reads cleanly without them because names are domain-specific and functions are short. Comments are reserved for non-obvious WHY, as in the fixed-point explanation at lev/loop.py:81-83.

Error handling is throw-based at real boundaries (cli.py wraps file read/JSON parse; router.py validates untyped dict input) with no copied try/except templates across files. Defensive checks appear only where input is genuinely untrusted.

tokenize, softmax, confidence, and raw_choice_scores in engine.py each do substantive work (stemming, normalization, evidence scoring); none are LLM-style argument-forwarding wrappers, so the codebase has no wrapper noise to filter.
